completed.detail: Closed the Original Gate Select 3D parity question from existing original evidence. No product code was changed and no gameplay was added.
completed.headline: The original Gate Select is a 3D world map, ROM_VERIFIED. OVL12 carries a traced NSBMD loader call (0x0210C6FC) whose sole caller passes gate_select/3D_worldMap_model, and that model contains 16 biome node pairs. The shipped 2D card grid is therefore not final parity.
recovered: 16 biome identities with exact node names and offsets: Canyon, Crag, Damp, Desert, Factory, Forest, Grass, Ice, Jungle, Mine, Oasis, Ruins, Savanna, Seaside, Sewer, Volcano - each a <Name>parent -> <Name> pair at a 16-byte stride.
Three independent counts of 16: model node pairs, obj_world_GateIcon cells, and field_image_icon cells.
Day/night as PAIRED nodes at both geometry (world_day / world_night) and texture (four Map_fix_* names in MDL0 and TEX0) level.
The destination record: field_icon, field_name, field_id, field_desc and money_alert, with node coordinates, from ui/hunt/world/world_sub_base_scene.nxr.
Gate Select is the only screen family with zero .nxr scenes, against 94 across 11 other families.
verifiedNegatives: Neither Gate Select model has any nsbca/nsbta/nsbma/nsbva. The ROM-wide 3D inventory is complete at 58 files and gate_select holds exactly 2, both .nsbmd. Any original 3D motion is code-driven, so a Three.js restoration must animate procedurally - with product-authored parameters, since the driving code is untraced.

gate_select/earth.nsbmd has no traced loader anywhere. The only `earth` string cross-reference is OVL19, which the census resolves to battle/earth_hit. An earth/space stage cannot be asserted as original on this evidence.
correctionsToResearch: GATE_SELECT_NODE_CANDIDATES.csv omits the biome node `Ice`. Recovered by reading 3D_worldMap_model.nsbmd at MDL0+672: hex 496365.
decoded_json/gate_select__earth.nsbmd.json omits the node `map`. Recovered by reading earth.nsbmd at MDL0+240.
stillUnknown: whether an earth stage precedes the world map

completed.detail: The Owner-authorized bounded OVL12 trace around 0x0210C6FC could not be performed. The original-evidence tree contains no ROM image, no overlay binary and no ARM9 binary; the existing per-subsystem trace files each state 'Bounded disassembly excerpt only. Raw overlay binary is not bundled.' There are no OVL12 instruction bytes to follow.
completed.whatWasNotDone: No behaviour was inferred to fill the gap. rotation, camera, input, hit-test, selection animation, the day/night switch rule and the earth consumer all remain UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_TRACE, exactly as before.
completed.whatWouldUnblock: The OVL12 overlay binary (file id 12, 39,200 bytes, RAM 0x0210b300), the ROM image, or a pre-extracted OVL12 disassembly excerpt around 0x0210C6FC in the same format as the existing OVL19/OVL8/ARM9 files.
recoveredAnyway: An independent second source for the overlay identity: the systems-handoff mode-flow map states OVL 12 = 'Gate select + Hunt loadout'.
Day/night has a proven gameplay consequence: both Light items are ROM-documented as night-only.

completed.detail: Closed the Original Hunt Loadout structure from existing evidence. All 11 Owner questions answered with per-field evidence levels. No product implementation.
completed.headline: The original loadout is five equipment classes - ROPE, SHOT, WIRE, ENTRAP, DAMAGE_TRAP - over a 79-item Hunt/Plugin catalogue, with 4 gear slots and 4 plugin positions. Plugins are information equipment: they decide what the Hunt HUD can display.
recovered: Five equipment classes corroborated from two independent sides: NXR touch-region names (col_rope/col_shot/col_wire/col_entrap/col_damage_trap) and the ROM's own five Checker item names (Shot/Wire/Entrap/DamageTrap/All Checker).
The shop table at base 0x020E0248, stride 0x38, 118 records: Training 4, Hunt 49, Plugins 30, Cages 35.
Ten Hunt subcategories - Rope, Shot, Wire, Meat, Decoy, Light, Bomb, Mine, Capture Trap, Memory Card - with caps, prices and ROM descriptions.
Rope is max_owned 1 with a durability stat; the four other classes cap at 99, matching the two-digit x NN readout on equip_plate and the four remain counters in the Hunt HUD.
Six single-purpose Analyzer plugins map one-for-one onto the six Hunt HUD creature fields: gen, type, align_text, hp, mind, size.
Availability is Shop-side: INITIAL_AVAILABLE 15, TAMER_RANK_THRESHOLD 65, BATTLE_BADGE_ID_0_BASED 38, with visibility at PlayerData +0x2F0.
Memory Cards define capture capacity in G, which the Memory Checker plugin displays through the mc_* HUD nodes.
